title: SHORTCUT FRAMES floor: a plain AppKit app's key-to-photon (layer keyDown, menu key equivalent, NSTextView typing), real HID, harness recorder set-up
why: Lead 2026-11-02: even Cmd-K in a terminal is 3 refreshes; measure the macOS pipeline's floor (HID -> WindowServer -> app -> CA commit -> render server -> display) on the same mini, 120 Hz virtual display and real HID keys, so every SHORTCUT FRAMES row reads as refreshes over the floor.
